FADE IN:

INT. VETERAN'S BEDROOM - DAY

We see a worn, old man, JAMES (75), lying in bed, surrounded by the remnants of a life long past. His eyes are sunken, his skin pale, and his hair thinning. He's trying to remember something, anything, from his past.

JAMES (V.O)
I remember... I remember... (pauses) Oh, the smell of mud and blood. The sound of gunfire. (looks around the room) Where am I?

He tries to sit up, but a wave of dizziness washes over him. He falls back onto the pillow, his eyes closing.

JAMES (V.O)
I was there... I was there... (pauses) A man... a man with a rifle... (looks to his side) No, no, no... (shakes his head)

Suddenly, a memory flashes before his eyes. He sees a man, dressed in a uniform, standing to his side. The man is holding a rifle, and James can see the fear in his eyes.

JAMES (V.O)
I remember... I remember... (pauses) He was shot... (covers his mouth) Oh, God...

The memory fades, and James is left staring at the wall, his eyes wide with horror.

JAMES (V.O)
What happened? What happened to him?

He tries to remember more, but his mind is a blank. He looks around the room, hoping to find some clue, some hint of what he's trying to remember.

JAMES (V.O)
I remember... I remember... (pauses) A man... a man with a rifle... (looks to his side again) No, no, no...

The memory flashes again, and James sees the man's brains fall out from the back of his head. He screams, his eyes wide with terror.

JAMES (V.O)
No! No! No!

The memory fades, and James is left gasping for breath, his eyes closed.

CUT TO:

INT. VETERAN'S BEDROOM - LATER

James is sitting in a chair, staring at a photograph on the table. It's a picture of a group of soldiers, smiling and laughing. James looks at the picture, trying to remember who they are.

JAMES (V.O)
I remember... I remember... (pauses) A group of men... (looks at the photograph) No, no, no...

He tries to remember more, but his mind is a blank. He looks at the photograph again, hoping to find some clue, some hint of what he's trying to remember.

CUT TO:

INT. VETERAN'S BEDROOM - LATER

James is lying in bed, his eyes closed. He's trying to remember something, anything, from his past.

JAMES (V.O)
I remember... I remember... (pauses) A man... a man with a rifle... (looks to his side) No, no, no...

The memory flashes again, and James sees the man's brains fall out from the back of his head. He screams, his eyes wide with terror.

JAMES (V.O)
No! No! No!

The memory fades, and James is left gasping for breath, his eyes closed.

FADE TO BLACK.
